description: Use this when the user asks what exhibitions are on in Madrid (architecture, design, photography, art), today or on some dates. Lists the ones Builtalist follows that are open on those days, each with its type, venue, dates, price and link. For now, only Madrid.

hasta.description: YYYY-MM-DD. The same day as "desde" if not given.

limite.description: How many works to give, from 1 to 20. 10 if not given.

texto.description: Words in the title, the type (arquitectura, fotografía, diseño), the artists or the venue.

name: buscar_exposiciones
title: Buscar exposiciones en Madrid
